prompt: Challenge C119-CH1: We produce roughly 600 packaging variants a year and our senior designer spends two days per project manually fitting artwork into structura

content.text: {"expertise":[{"text":"Parametric dieline generation can represent carton geometry as dimensioned features linked by dependency rules, allowing rapid recalculation when dimensions change.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-07151","field":"abstract","quote":"The system represents carton geometry as a directed acyclic graph of dimensioned features—panels, score lines, glue flaps, and tuck tongues—each linked by algebraic dependency rules."}]},{"text":"Artwork-to-substrate registration algorithms and constraint-based layout optimization methods are core research areas for automating graphic reproduction workflows.","sources":[{"id":"R0626","field":"bio","quote":"Her research group focuses on computational methods for automating graphic reproduction workflows, including parametric dieline construction, artwork-to-substrate registration algorithms, and color-managed PDF processing pipelines."}]},{"text":"PDF/X compliance verification and prepress automation can be integrated into hot-folder workflows to catch artwork conformance errors before production.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-07153","field":"abstract","quote":"Integration into a hot-folder workflow is described."}]}],"fit":"partial","fitReason":"The researcher has developed parametric dieline systems [SYN-PUB-07151] and artwork-to-substrate registration methods [R0626] that address layout automation, but the published work focuses on dieline generation and compliance verification rather than automated artwork placement and scaling into existing dieline structures, which is the core challenge."}
